bar.name: Four hand-written no-kit apps by a strong model (habits, workouts, budget, journal), blind strips at 412x915
bar.pin: baseline shots archived in molde-design/archive-2026-11-23; candidate PR #36 @ 948f3c6

biggest_gap: Both blind critics again chose the baseline: the chat button rests on top of rows and controls (it blocks the first habit tick), screens open with no header-plus-primary-action row, and the settings sheet's Done needs two taps after an edit.

acceptance.line: every demo program renders clean at 5 viewports, light and dark
acceptance.evidence: both critics: 90 loads each, 0 console output, 0 overflow, targets >= 44 px, text >= 14 px; 200% text has no overflow but a few clipped labels
no app words in render.mjs or molde.css; but layout heuristics (centre short screens, draw size caps, number+unit split) are tuned to the demo programs

acceptance.line: edits and undo never lose data entered by the user
acceptance.evidence: chat change/Undo/redo keeps every row and setting in all 15 apps (fixed); but Undo of a 'new app' request discards rows entered in the new app, and the demo picker reseeds an app without saying so

acceptance.line: blind critic does not prefer the hand-written no-kit baseline on look and usefulness
acceptance.evidence: both critics picked the baseline (clear): it has a title + primary action row, labelled heat-grid days, sized accent buttons; ours: chat button over content, ragged chip picker, black selected heat cell, mixed number formats

other_notes: S1/S2: settings sheet Done does nothing on the first tap after editing a value (blur re-render replaces the button); Tab then Enter also fails. Medicine shows '2 of 1 doses taken' after deleting doses.

S2: centring rule leaves empty list apps floating mid-screen (quiz, todo, reading); heat grid selected cell collides with the data ramp and its legend is wrong in dark mode; 42 unnamed tab stops ('Open') in habits; empty states with blank or zero noise.
S3: 'Rs 5322' beside 'Rs 26,610'; savings bars without month names; two-tick y axes; late tasks shown by colour only; '1 days'; only the last chat message offers Undo.
